from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib,re
from datetime import datetime
d=Path('reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1')
protocol=json.loads((d/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert (d/'freeze.json').is_file() and not (d/'sources').exists()
out=d/'sources';out.mkdir()
url=protocol['source_scope']['catalog_url']
r=requests.get(url,timeout=40);r.raise_for_status()
(out/'官方按年声明目录.html').write_bytes(r.content)
soup=BeautifulSoup(r.content,'html.parser')
main=soup.select_one('article') or soup.select_one('main')
print(main.get_text('\n',strip=True)[-20000:])
links=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'href':a.get('href')} for a in main.select('a[href]')]
(out/'目录链接.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
(d/'catalog_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'retrieved_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'url':url,'http_status':r.status_code,'bytes':len(r.content),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
